The fact that the account linked the track establishes an association with this post; it does not by itself establish ownership, licensing, authorship by Toadgod, or any broader rights to redistribute the audio.

- This post does **not** state a new Deed, SEED, Rune3, yield, migration, market, or release mechanic. Its strongest documented function is a textual + musical continuation of the world-awakening theme.
